name: Adaptive smooth-poly with logit penalty
tagline: Cross-entropy with progress-scheduled label smoothing, a Poly-1 correction (heavier for many-class tasks), and a small logit-norm calibration penalty.
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond the fixed-eps label smoothing baseline by linearly ramping the smoothing strength with epoch and adding a class-count-aware Poly-1 term plus a small logit-norm penalty for calibration; differs from poly_loss by adding both adaptive smoothing and the logit penalty.

name: Curriculum poly with temperature anneal
tagline: Smoothed cross-entropy plus a Poly-1 correction whose weight decays as (1-progress)^γ, with logits rescaled by an annealed temperature.
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes the constant-eps Poly baseline by making the polynomial weight a (1-progress)^γ curriculum and warming up logits with a decaying softmax temperature, so optimization is softer early and sharper late.

name: CAMP: curriculum margin + smoothing + poly
tagline: Subtracts a growing additive margin from the true-class logit, ramps label smoothing, and adds a Poly-1 hard-example correction.
diff_from_baseline: Stacks three adaptations on the label-smoothing/poly baselines: an additive logit margin that grows with training, jointly ramped smoothing, and a fixed Poly-1 hard-example term — none used by the three reference baselines individually.

name: Negative-smoothing CE + ranking margin
tagline: Temperature-scaled CE with a softmax-over-non-target distribution as smoothing, plus a Poly-1 correction and a softplus margin penalty between top non-target and true logit.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces uniform label smoothing with a teacher-style soft target derived from the model's own non-target softmax, then layers a poly correction and a softplus pairwise margin penalty against the hardest negative — none of which appear in the label_smoothing/focal/poly baselines.

name: AFPL: adaptive focal + poly + smoothing
tagline: Focal-weighted cross-entropy with class-count-scaled label smoothing, decaying focal γ, and a square-root-progressing Poly-1 term.
diff_from_baseline: Combines the focal_loss and label_smoothing/poly_loss baselines with all three weights scheduled across training: focal γ decays, smoothing decays, and a Poly-1 correction grows — yielding a single loss that morphs from focal-emphasised early to poly-style late.
